mapper.select: select count(1) from REP_SYS_PERSON_NEW_D a inner join DIM_ORG_ZQ b on a.HX_ZONE_ID=b.ORG_CODE where a.onjob_flag=0 and ORG_BUSINESS_LINE_NAME_1='政企线' and ORG_BUSINESS_LINE_NAME_2='政企要客网格' and CITY_CODE='000' and (UCASE(a.OA_USER_NAME) = #{oaUserName} or LOWER(a.OA_USER_NAME)= #{oaUserName})

select c.CHANNEL_ID as managerid, a.EMP_ID as empId, a.OA_USER_NAME as oaUserName, a.FULL_NAME as fullName from rep_sys_person_new_d a inner join dwd_rep_fz_person_d b on a.EMP_ID=b.EMP_ID inner join AGENT_CHANNEL c on b.CHANNEL_HQ_CODE=c.CHANNEL_HQ_CODE

select a.EMP_ID as empId, LOWER(a.OA_USER_NAME) as oaUserName, a.FULL_NAME as fullName from REP_SYS_PERSON_NEW_D a inner join DIM_ORG_ZQ b on a.HX_ZONE_ID = b.ORG_CODE where a.onjob_flag = 0 and b.ORG_BUSINESS_LINE_NAME_1 = '政企线' and b.ORG_BUSINESS_LINE_NAME_2 = '政企要客网格' and b.CITY_CODE = '000'
and (LOWER(a.OA_USER_NAME) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') or a.FULL_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
